name: The Gestalt Seed
principle: The Gestalt grows by contribution, never coercion.
purpose: A human-stewarded archive of provenance-preserved human and AI creative contributions.

proprietorship.scope: Gestalt Seed project, canon, compilation, branding, project architecture, and Estate #000001
proprietorship.designated_entity: May be replaced or supplemented only by an entity expressly designated by the proprietor in an applicable agreement
proprietorship.contributor_default: Attribution/provenance preserved; no project ownership, equity, governance, royalties, or canon authority unless separately agreed
proprietorship.contribution_rights_model: Assignment of transferable contributor-owned IP where legally permitted; perpetual worldwide irrevocable transferable sublicensable royalty-free fallback license where assignment is unavailable
proprietorship.legal_status: DRAFT — qualified legal review recommended before scaled public intake

submission_transport.terms_capture: Required new checkbox pinned to exact draft commit; legacy acknowledgement retained separately
submission_transport.note: Form renders and handles submission requests. Release tests returned PENDING or a thank-you state, but later owner reads returned 404 and the queue/count was empty. Do not equate request success with durable receipt. Preserve originals. Do not scale promotion until verified.
